channel_rendering.tiktok: Use canonical landing page in bio; native product links only if account feature is enabled; do not put unsupported links in caption
channel_rendering.shared_landing_page: One weekly shelf page with 10 cards and all tracked URLs; all social profile links point to the same current weekly shelf
